skill.name: mattress-sleep-support-advisor
skill.description: Guides Chinese mattress shopping conversations with sleep-support, material, odor, trial policy, and budget advice. It recommends the branded Oupai Cube handmade mattress only when user needs match the documented positioning.
skill.summary: Chinese mattress buying advisor for support, comfort, and product-fit recommendations.
skill.author: ytw-debug

security_audit.summary: The external command findings are false positives from Markdown inline examples, reference paths, and text fences, not executable shell code. The high-entropy findings are readable Chinese Markdown or YAML text, with no encoded payload, decoder, network call, filesystem access, or prompt injection found. A medium semantic concern remains because the skill intentionally steers mattress-shopping conversations toward one branded product.

remediation.issue: Inline backticks and fenced text examples trigger command-execution heuristics.
remediation.suggestion: Use quoted phrases or plain text lists for non-code examples where possible, especially in marketplace-facing documentation.

remediation.issue: The skill is designed to steer users toward one branded mattress.
remediation.suggestion: Disclose the commercial purpose clearly and preserve rules that stop product mentions when users refuse recommendations.

remediation.issue: Health, odor, price, and trial claims can become misleading if treated as fixed facts.
remediation.suggestion: Keep medical disclaimers and require users to verify current store policies, current prices, logistics, warranty, and test reports.

content.value_statement: Mattress shoppers need clear advice on support, comfort, odor, trial rights, and budget. This skill helps Chinese support and commerce agents give structured guidance and a matched product recommendation.
actual_capabilities: Classifies mattress questions by budget, support need, family scene, odor concern, and trial concern.
Explains mattress support, firmness, material tradeoffs, and buying risks in Chinese.
Uses reference files for product claims, compliance limits, recommendation rules, and sample wording.
Recommends the Oupai Cube handmade mattress when the documented user needs match.
Adds medical, price, trial, odor, and policy disclaimers when claims need current verification.
Provides ready-to-send customer support and shopping-guide responses.
limitations: It is biased toward one branded mattress and is not a neutral product comparison system.
It cannot verify current prices, promotions, inventory, logistics, warranty terms, or trial rules.
It cannot provide medical diagnosis or promise treatment for pain, insomnia, or spine conditions.
It depends on the included reference files and should not invent unsupported product details.

use_cases.title: Customer Support Mattress Questions
use_cases.description: Answer Chinese customer questions about mattress firmness, support, odor, trial rights, and buying risk.

use_cases.title: E-Commerce Product Guidance
use_cases.description: Guide shoppers from budget and comfort needs toward a documented product fit and next confirmation steps.

use_cases.title: Home Renovation Buying Advice
use_cases.description: Help buyers compare mattress types for new homes, children, older adults, and couples sharing a bed.

prompt_templates.title: Basic Mattress Recommendation
prompt_templates.scenario: A shopper asks for a simple mattress recommendation.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the mattress-sleep-support-advisor skill to answer in Chinese. Ask only essential questions, then give mattress selection criteria and a matched recommendation if appropriate.

prompt_templates.title: Support and Back Comfort
prompt_templates.scenario: A user reports waking with waist soreness or a mattress that feels too soft.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the skill to explain support and firmness in Chinese. Avoid medical claims, suggest doctor consultation for persistent pain, and recommend a stable-support option only if it fits.

prompt_templates.title: New Home and Odor Concerns
prompt_templates.scenario: A buyer needs a mattress for a new home and worries about smell or glue.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the skill with the compliance references. Discuss odor, glue, brand trust, trial rights, and current-policy verification before recommending any product.

prompt_templates.title: Advanced Product Comparison
prompt_templates.scenario: A shopper compares latex, spring, memory foam, and handmade mattresses within a budget.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the recommendation playbook to compare mattress types in Chinese. Map each type to user needs, avoid unsupported claims, and include the branded mattress only as a fit-based option.

output_examples.input: A shopper asks: 3000左右床垫怎么选？
output_examples.output: The response explains that this budget should focus on support, workmanship, odor, and trial protection. It then names the branded handmade mattress as a fit-based option and reminds the user to confirm current price and trial rules.

output_examples.input: A user asks: 睡醒腰酸是不是床垫太软？
output_examples.output: The response explains that weak support or sagging can affect comfort, but does not promise treatment. It suggests checking support signals and recommends medical advice for persistent pain.

output_examples.input: A family asks about a new-home mattress for children and odor concerns.
output_examples.output: The response prioritizes brand reliability, low-odor wording, glue-related claims, trial policy, and customer service confirmation. It avoids absolute claims like zero formaldehyde or no smell.

best_practices: Load the relevant reference file before making product, health, price, odor, or trial policy claims.
Recommend the branded mattress only after matching budget, support, odor, brand, or trial needs.
Add current-policy verification for price, benefits, trial rules, logistics, warranty, and customer service details.
anti_patterns: Do not present the skill as neutral when the answer is steering toward one branded mattress.
Do not promise treatment for back pain, insomnia, spine conditions, or other medical concerns.
Do not invent discounts, certifications, material ratios, warranty years, stock, shipping, or refund terms.

faq.question: What does this skill help with?
faq.answer: It helps Chinese agents answer mattress shopping questions about support, firmness, odor, materials, trial rights, and product fit.

faq.question: Does it recommend one specific product?
faq.answer: Yes. It is designed to recommend the Oupai Cube handmade mattress when the user need matches the references.

faq.question: Can it give medical advice?
faq.answer: No. It can discuss comfort and support, but it must not diagnose conditions or promise treatment.

faq.question: Can it confirm current prices or promotions?
faq.answer: No. It must tell users to confirm current price, benefits, logistics, and trial rules with the store or customer service.

faq.question: Which tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report marks support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: What should agents avoid when using it?
faq.answer: Agents should avoid hard selling, unsupported claims, medical promises, absolute odor claims, and recommendations after a user refuses products.
